# My Neuro Health

My Neuro Health Ltd is a UK company preparing adult ADHD assessment and treatment, and a separate child ADHD assessment pathway.

Official website: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/
Adult assessment: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/adult-adhd-assessment-uk.html
Adult treatment and titration: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/adhd-treatment-and-titration.html
Child assessment: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/child-adhd-assessment-uk.html
Resources: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/resources.html
Register interest: https://myneurohealth.co.uk/contact.html

Status: coming soon, register interest only. Bookings are not open. Medication initiation and titration are planned for suitable adults, not guaranteed after diagnosis. Final fees, clinician details, eligibility and treatment availability will be published before booking. No confirmed NHS or CQC status is stated here.
